title: Selfie Looks Yellow? Check the Room Light and Screen Color
description: If a selfie looks yellow, start with neutral screen light and reduce competing warm room light, then check a saved photo.
direct: If a selfie looks yellow, start with neutral screen light and reduce competing warm room light, then check a saved photo. Screen color, room lighting and camera white balance all influence the result.
figureAlt: A person uses neutral phone screen light near a window with a room lamp off.
figureCaption: AI-generated conceptual illustration, not an App screenshot, measured result or real export.
cards.choice.heading: Change one light source at a time
cards.choice.body: A nearby warm lamp can tint skin even when the phone screen looks white. Move toward softer neutral light or switch off an unnecessary competing lamp when practical. Keep the phone and face in a similar position while testing so the comparison is meaningful.
sections.explain.heading: Avoid chasing a perfect preview
sections.explain.body: The camera may adapt its exposure or white balance between frames. A white screen is a starting point, not a calibrated daylight source, and GlowPop is not claimed to provide manual Kelvin white balance or a color-calibration tool. Do not judge skin color from a brightly tinted screen alone.
sections.practice.heading: Use the app’s actual controls
sections.practice.body: Space Sheep Studio develops GlowPop for iPhone. It offers a front-camera mirror with adjustable screen color and brightness while the camera stays open. Your first five photos are free, including white-light photos; Pro unlocks unlimited photos and video recording. This guide changes capture lighting rather than digitally repairing skin. No exact color match or measured improvement is promised, and the illustration is conceptual.

steps.step-1.text: Open GlowPop: Selfie Glow Camera and choose a neutral screen color with comfortable brightness.
steps.step-2.text: Check whether a room lamp or colored wall is adding a cast. Adjust that source before cycling through strongly colored screen options.
steps.step-3.text: Take a photo and inspect the saved result. If needed, make one small light-color change and capture another test.
